rejectionReason: The semantic cancellation fix passes focused tests, but the native first project shows38 skeleton frames and warm picker p95 regresses109→126 ms. First cross-project Page still loads at291/332 ms (native/web). The ticket criteria and daily qualitative validation remain unmet.
limitations: The bounded Page worker caches its working set, filters unrelated events and preserves renewal deadlines. The closed project-picker dropdown no longer intercepts board hit points. Initial read, invalidation, permission and versioned write gates remain authoritative.
Cold observations and startup are not population p95; executable launch is excluded.
The preparation interval is ten seconds. Large diffs and review-rich PRs remain unverified.

Cold project access still requires preparation; document bodies are renewed only within the bounded working set. Retained document selection and the complete project-to-document flow are separate metrics; the latter includes driver time between its component clicks.
The Tiptap Editor instance is recreated after Activity suspension; reconciled document content is restored, without promising retained undo histories.
Every PR subview has five observations, so its p95 is intentionally absent. Only PR alternation reaches twenty-five samples.
privacyReview: Decoded archives checked for credential patterns, body/header fields and URL queries. Shared issue data retained only as a digest.
